support: Need help? <contact>Contact the NEAR Auth team</contact>.

signIn.title: Sign in to manage your dApp
signIn.description: Use your NEAR Auth account. Your dApp is registered to the email address you sign in with.

signingIn.title: Signing you in
signingIn.inProgress: Complete sign-in in the NEAR Auth window.
signingIn.popupBlocked: Your browser blocked the sign-in window
signingIn.popupBlockedDescription: Continue in this tab instead; you will come back here once you have signed in.

missingEmail.title: Your account has no email address
missingEmail.description: The console registers each dApp to its owner's email, and the way you signed in did not share one. Sign out and sign in with a method that does, such as Google or email and password.

verifyEmail.title: Verify your email
verifyEmail.description: Open the verification email NEAR Auth sent to {{email}} and follow its link, then come back here.
verifyEmail.refreshFailed: We could not refresh your session
verifyEmail.refreshFailedDescription: Try again, or sign out and sign in again.
verifyEmail.notVerified: Your email is not verified yet
verifyEmail.notVerifiedDescription: Follow the link in the verification email, then check again. It can take a minute to arrive.
verifyEmail.support: No email? <contact>Contact the NEAR Auth team</contact>.

loadError.session: Your session could not be checked

refreshError: Could not refresh, so this may be out of date

myDapp.loadError: Your dApp could not be loaded

noDapp.title: You haven't registered a dApp yet
noDapp.description: Register your dApp to get a dedicated Auth0 clientId and access to the {{network}} NEAR Auth contract. Each email address can have one dApp at a time, and yours is {{email}}.
noDapp.legacy: Already approved through the earlier application form? That client keeps working but isn't managed here. <contact>Contact the NEAR Auth team</contact> to change it.

register.title: Register your dApp
register.description: Tell us about your app. Once approved you get a dedicated Auth0 clientId and access to the {{network}} NEAR Auth contract.
register.info: The name, description, logo and URLs become your Auth0 application's settings. You can change any field later. See <apply>how the approval process works</apply>.
register.submitHint: The NEAR Auth team reviews it before it goes live.

pending.reviewDescription: The NEAR Auth team is reviewing your application.
pending.wait: You can keep editing the details below while you wait.

rejected.title: Your application was not approved
rejected.resubmit: Update the details below and resubmit. Your dApp goes straight back into the review queue.

changeUnderReview.title: Change under review
changeUnderReview.description: Your live settings stay as they are until the NEAR Auth team approves it. To withdraw it, edit the fields back to their live values or use Withdraw change.

credentials.title: {{network}} credentials
credentials.note: Your client ID is public because it ships in your app's code. Only your registered callback URLs and web origins can use it.
credentials.goLiveDescription: Point your provider at {{network}} with your client ID. The rest of your integration stays the same.
credentials.tip: Use the {{network}} account ids when you construct the client. See <resources>{{name}} resources</resources>.

myDapp.approvalRule: Changes go live once the NEAR Auth team approves them.

edit.pendingNote: Your dApp is still in review. Saved edits keep it in the queue, so you don't need to resubmit.
edit.rejectedNote: Fix what the review flagged, then resubmit.
edit.resubmitHint: Resubmitting puts the dApp back in the review queue.

changed.title: Nothing was done
changed.description: Your dApp changed since you opened that dialog. Check its latest version below, then try again.

withdraw.title: Withdraw the change?
withdraw.description: The NEAR Auth team will not review it, and your live settings stay as they are.

remove.title: Remove {{name}}?
remove.live: This deletes the dApp and its Auth0 application. Logins through client ID {{clientId}} stop working immediately.
remove.pending: This deletes the dApp and takes it out of the review queue.
remove.final: It can't be undone. A new dApp can be submitted afterwards with the same email.

dapps.title: dApps
dapps.description: Applications registered for NEAR Auth. Approving one creates its Auth0 application.
dapps.searchPlaceholder: Search by name, email or client ID
dapps.loadError: The dApps could not be loaded

dapp.loadError: The dApp could not be loaded
dapp.editBlocked: Approve or reject the pending change before editing.

changed.title: Nothing was done
changed.description: This dApp changed since you opened that dialog. Review its latest version below, then decide again.

auth0Error.title: The last Auth0 call failed
auth0Error.nothingSaved: The console saved nothing, though Auth0 may hold part of the failed write. Retrying the same action is safe; this clears after the next successful Auth0 write.
auth0Error.rejected: If this came from the rejection, the rejection went through and the console left this Auth0 client in place because it is not tagged as this dApp's. Check in the Auth0 dashboard what uses it before you delete it there by hand. If it came from a removal, the console saved nothing and retrying it is safe.
auth0Error.removed: The removal went through, but the console left this Auth0 client in place because it is not tagged as this dApp's. Check in the Auth0 dashboard what uses it before you delete it there by hand.

dangerZone.title: Danger zone
dangerZone.description: Deletes its Auth0 application, if any; the record and its activity log are kept. You'll be asked to confirm. The owner can submit again with the same email.

liveSave.title: Apply changes to the live app?
liveSave.description: {{name}} is approved and live. Saving updates its Auth0 application immediately. A wrong callback URL or origin breaks login for its users until it is fixed.

approveDialog.title: Approve {{name}}?
approveDialog.description: This creates its Auth0 application. The dApp can authenticate real users immediately.
approveDialog.note: Later owner changes come back for review. You can remove the dApp at any time.

rejectDialog.title: Reject {{name}}?
rejectDialog.description: The owner sees the rejection on their dashboard. They can fix the issues and resubmit.

approveChangeDialog.title: Approve the change?
approveChangeDialog.description: This applies the proposed values. The Auth0 application is updated when the name, description, logo or URLs change.

rejectChangeDialog.title: Reject the change?
rejectChangeDialog.description: The live values stay as they are.

removeDialog.title: Remove {{name}}?
removeDialog.live: This deletes its Auth0 application. Logins through client ID {{clientId}} stop working immediately.
removeDialog.noClient: It has no Auth0 application yet, so no logins are affected.
removeDialog.note: The record and its activity log are kept.

facts.ownerNote: · signs in to manage this dApp

record.noClient: No Auth0 application yet. Approving creates one from these details.
record.title: Record

activity.title: Activity
activity.loadError: The activity could not be loaded

dappForm.liveDescription: Changes to the name, description, logo or URLs update its Auth0 client at once.

application.title: Application
application.hint: Shown to your users on the NEAR Auth login and transaction-approval screens.

capacity.title: Capacity
capacity.hint: Lets us provision capacity and set rate limits for your app.

urls.title: Whitelisted URLs
urls.hint: Register production and staging together. Add one entry per environment.
urls.https: HTTPS is required for every URL. Plain http:// URLs are rejected.

contact.title: Contact
contact.hint: How the NEAR Auth team can reach your team about your app.

name.label: Application name
name.hint: The public-facing name people recognize, such as Acme Wallet. Up to {{max}} characters (most emoji count as two or more).

description.label: Application description
description.hint: One or two sentences, written for end users, up to {{max}} characters (most emoji count as two or more). Appears next to your name during login.
description.placeholder: A non-custodial wallet for buying and sending NEAR.

logoUrl.label: Application logo
logoUrl.hint: A square PNG or SVG (recommended 256×256 px) served over HTTPS.

callbackUrls.label: Callback URLs
callbackUrls.hint: Where NEAR Auth may redirect after login and after a signature request. Must match the redirectUri you configure in the SDK.

logoutUrls.label: Logout URLs
logoutUrls.hint: Only needed if you pass a return URL when calling logout.

webOrigins.label: Web origins
webOrigins.hint: Scheme + domain, no path. Only these origins can start the auth flow (CORS).

contactEmail.label: Primary contact email
contactEmail.hint: A monitored alias like dev@example.com works best.
